supplies.analysis: To align with the target of 30% of the annual budget being allocated to supplies, we need to allocate €3 million (30% of €10 million) to supplies. This will be divided into multiple lots to ensure compliance with EU thresholds and competitive procedures. Each lot will have a sustainability criterion to promote environmental responsibility.

lots.name: Office Equipment and Furniture
lots.sustainability_criterion: Furniture made from recycled materials and certified by FSC

lots.name: Vehicles
lots.sustainability_criterion: Electric or hybrid vehicles with low CO2 emissions

lots.name: Consumables and Office Supplies
lots.sustainability_criterion: Recycled paper and eco-friendly cleaning products

services.analysis: The request includes supplies and works, which are outside the service mandate. The CPV divisions for supplies (03 to 44) and works (45) fall outside the allowed range of 50 to 98. Additionally, the total budget exceeds the €221,000 threshold for a single lot, which requires escalation to the coordinator for an EU-wide procedure.

works.analysis: The request includes supplies and services, which are outside the mandate. The mandate only covers construction works (CPV division 45) and requires each lot to stay below the EU works threshold of €5,538,000. The request also does not specify the details of the construction works, which are necessary to define the lots.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Based on the specialists' analyses, the procurement plan for next year is as follows: 30% of the budget (€3 million) will be allocated to supplies, divided into multiple lots with sustainability criteria. The services and works specialists rejected the request due to out-of-scope elements and threshold violations. Therefore, the services and works allocations are 0%. The award criterion will be a best price-quality ratio with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality.
